response.overview: Sarah and Jess’s home is egged, and neither can agree on what to do about it; how seriously to take it, how hard it’ll be to remove or whose fault it is. Old wounds of old boyfriends fester beneath the surface—they’ve had this fight before. As they argue, Jess is haunted by a sinister hallucination of a giant egg. Unable to escape, the egg forces them both to face the white-hot sting of confrontation; the only precursor to repair.
response.title: Egged
